name: template-context-reserved
body: The `deck`, `slide`, `item`, `raw` and `data` context keys must be reserved top-level template-context names available in every slide layout and every section instance at every composition depth (`item` is nil/absent at slide level; `raw` and `data` are the source and authored-section data views, raw-source-context and section-data-context); a template declaring a field or section named `deck`, `slide`, `item`, `raw` or `data` is a templates error at load time. Exposing this context adds no layout helper: the helper set is the documented one (`media`, `section`, `dict`, `list`), independent of the context keys.
